terra.problem: The contrast about the company not being God makes the everyday comparison confusing and gives it a preachy turn.
The verse names incense and oil on the table, but it does not say gold and silver are nowhere on it.
The burning of the houses does not come immediately after the stoning and swords. The verse also says the mob will kill their sons and daughters before mentioning the houses.
The verse says the houses will be burned down, but it does not say they are never taken over or that nobody moves into them.
Mentioning that this is the last passage in the group refers to how the lessons are organized, which Papa Dorin does not discuss.
The verse does not say that nobody is coming to rescue the sisters.
